<thought>Search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic transformation that reverses a carbonyl‑ene reaction: in the forward direction it forms a C‑O bond (hydroxyl) and a C‑C bond while breaking a C=O (ketone) and a C=C (alkene). This should give a single‑step disconnection of the target into a keto‑alkene precursor.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "[CH2:1]=[C:2]([c:3]1[cH:4][cH:5][cH:6][cH:7][cH:8]1)[C@@H:9]1[CH2:10][CH2:11][CH2:12][C@@:13]1([OH:14])[C:15]([F:16])([F:17])[F:18]",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["ketone", "alkene"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["hydroxyl", "five-membered ring"],
  "bonds_formed": ["C-O", "C-C"],
  "bonds_broken": ["C=O", "C=C"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
